description: This file is a source code file for a C project, implementing plugin loading mechanisms including dynamic shared object (.so) and JSON plugins, with functions to load, initialize, and free plugins, along with external reference handling.

methods.description: Frees a loaded .so plugin, calling cleanup methods and closing the handle.

methods.name: int bbfdm_free_json_plugin(void)
